channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gary Harris | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gary Harris from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Malone on Gary Harris, RJ Hampton
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on yesterday's trade:

“I would be remissed if I didn't say, thank you Gary Harris. Thank you RJ Hampton.”

Michael Malone on Gary Harris, RJ Hampton, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on JaMychal Green, Gary Harris, Michael Porter
item.description:
“We were without two starters tonight -- no Gary Harris, no Michael Porter. I don't think we have been whole the whole year. JaMychal Green was out early, Michael Porter has been out with COVID, and Gary was not here due to personal reasons. I think that's one thing that will help us.”

Michael Malone on JaMychal Green, Gary Harris, Michael Porter, Jan 13, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Malone on Gary Harris
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Malone on Gary Harris' preseason opener:

“Gary's going to be a really, really important piece to our team this year... I thought Gary was good for us the other night but I believe 1-15, all of us can be a lot better.”

Michael Malone on Gary Harris, Dec 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Gary Harris
item.description:
Malone on Gary Harris:

“Gary knows that I do believe in him. I think he knows that I stuck with him, that I gave him a chance when I first got here and I stayed with him for five years.”

Michael Malone on Gary Harris, Oct 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Gary Harris
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Gary Harris:

“I know there's a lot of people out there that questioned Gary and have been hating on Gary about his offense. Hopefully after last night's performance which allowed us to tie the series up, people will give Gary a little bit of a break.”

Michael Malone on Gary Harris, Sep 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Porter Jr on Donovan Mitchell, Gary Harris
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Porter Jr. on Gary Harris:

“G is a really, really good player and he's really underappreciated at times. To see him knock down those threes in the fourth quarter. To see him get that big stop against Donovan Mitchell in Game 7...We all missed him a lot.”

Michael Porter Jr on Donovan Mitchell, Gary Harris, Sep 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Will Barton, Gary Harris, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Michael Singer:Malone on Murray, Barton or Harris’ availability:

“Keep hope alive ... Maybe one of those guys, but very very questionable.”

Michael Malone on Will Barton, Gary Harris, Jamal Murray, Aug 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Gary Harris
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Jokic on Gary Harris' hot start:

“He scored a lot, I think in the first quarter and I think we kind of stopped him. I think we could do a better job of that. When someone is hot just give him the ball more.”

Nikola Jokic on Gary Harris, Dec 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Gary Harris
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:LaMarcus Aldridge on the Nuggets contacting the league regarding his collision with Gary Harris while fighting through a screen late in Game 2:

“I'm not a dirty player. I was just trying to get out of the way. I'm not that guy. I'm not worried about it.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Gary Harris, Apr 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Draymond Green on Gary Harris
item.description:
“Some of them are questionable. Like Klay's one, Gary Harris is a hell of a cutter, you got to be into his body. He's flying off the screen to his right hand, he's great at that. So you body up and then you get called for going over the screen, I don't know what you do right there, but in the same sense some of the fouls we have are just dumb as hell. Like we're in the bonus like six, seven, eight minutes to go in every quarter, we're still fouling -- so I think some of [the calls] are a bit questionable and then some of them are on us, just ridiculous.”

Draymond Green on Gary Harris, Oct 22, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Malone on Gary Harris
item.description:
Nuggets coachMichael Malone on Gary Harris:

“Like Apollo Creed said, there's no tomorrow. If I have to play Gary Harris 30 minutes tonight, I'll play Gary Harris 30 minutes tonight.”

Michael Malone on Gary Harris, Apr 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Gary Harris
item.description:
Gina Mizell:Michael Malone on Gary Harris returning to the #Nuggets:

“Of course, we like our odds a lot better when Gary Harris plays, but family takes all... We want our players to know that we care about them as people. If you need to go home for a family situation, you have our support.”

Michael Malone on Gary Harris, Jan 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Michael Malone on Gary Harris, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray
item.description:
“You take bad fouls. You take bad shots. Your body language does this and that. You think it's just about you. But what do you think Jamal [Murray] is looking at? What do you think Gary Harris is looking at? All eyes are on you. If you do that stuff, it filters down. At the end of the day, Nikola knows I love him.”

Michael Malone on Gary Harris, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Nov 16, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Malone on Gary Harris
item.description:
Malone on Harris:

“It’s good to see him on the court (Friday). And as is always the case, how does he feel the next day. He’s just not there yet. So he’s still out.”

Michael Malone on Gary Harris, Oct 30, 2016. Source: Denver Post.
